title: AIGame LLM Settings
description: Device-local LLM setup. Never stored in cards, presets, or saves, because it holds API keys.

connections.description: Saved provider logins. A model slot points at one of these.

provider.description: anthropic uses the Messages API. All others use OpenAI-compatible chat completions; the provider only pre-fills base_url.

main.description: Writes the narration. Uses the active preset.

utility.description: Optional second model for small jobs. When unset, every task runs on main.

tasks.description: Which slot handles each helper job. Ignored when models.utility is unset. The list is open: the engine adds new helper jobs (e.g. scene direction) over time, and any job not listed here runs on utility.

resolve_actions.description: Turn player free text into actions before narration.

summarize.description: Fold old turns into the running summary.

enabled.description: Only meaningful on utility: lets the player switch it off without losing what they entered.

model.description: Model id as the provider names it.
